title: Model-dependent agent loop budgets
description: Make agent loop budgets (readBudget, exploreBudget, stepsPerRound) model-dependent. Strong models get higher budgets; weak/local models keep the current tight values. Tier is resolved at agent startup from the provider config and passed into the loop.

stories.title: Model-tier budget constants
stories.description: Define a ModelTier type ('strong' | 'weak') and a getBudgets(tier) function that returns {readBudget, exploreBudget, stepsPerRound}. Weak returns current hard-coded values (4, 3, 6). Strong returns higher values (8, 6, 12).
acceptance_criteria: A ModelTier type is exported from a new or existing agent module

stories.title: Tier field on ProviderConfig
stories.description: Add an optional defaultTier field to ProviderConfig. openrouter defaults to 'strong'; ollama defaults to 'weak'. The router exposes the tier via ResolvedProvider.
acceptance_criteria: ProviderConfig has an optional defaultTier: ModelTier field
ResolvedProvider exposes a tier: ModelTier field set from the provider's defaultTier (defaulting to 'weak' when absent)
Existing provider tests are updated or extended to cover the new field

stories.title: Wire tier-derived budgets into the agent command
stories.description: In runAgent (commands/agent.ts), resolve the tier from the provider, call getBudgets(tier), and use the returned values for ToolState construction, stepsPerRound, and the maxRounds fallback comment. Remove the current hard-coded literals.
acceptance_criteria: runAgent reads tier from the resolved provider
ToolState is constructed with readBudget and exploreBudget from getBudgets(tier)
stepsPerRound passed to runAgentLoop comes from getBudgets(tier)
A strong-tier model receives higher budget values than a weak-tier model
No budget literals (4, 3, 6) remain hard-coded in commands/agent.ts
